svg.aria-label: How the Best Buy Product Locator finds a store. On a product page on Amazon, Walmart or Target, it reads the model number out of the spec table, or the UPC on Target, and if it finds no code within 3 seconds it searches by the product's title instead. It asks the Best Buy API for that product and takes the first match. Then it takes your location, asks the Best Buy API for stores within 15 miles, and picks the nearest Big Box store. A banner drops onto the page with the price, the store, its hours today and a button to buy it on BestBuy.com, and the toolbar icon gets a badge and a popup that shows the same.
